title: Add campaign binding and module progress state
description:
Add the campaign-owned adventure run / module binding and mutable module progress to campaign instance state.

A campaign should be able to say which module or modules are active without copying or mutating the authored module source. This is done with a campaign-owned structured object - acceptable names include AdventureRun, CampaignModuleBinding, ActiveAdventureModule, or ModuleProgressState - that references the immutable module by id and records module-specific progress. This object is part of campaign instance state (the fourth layer in ADR 0012); it is NOT a fifth content/state layer and must not be modeled as a separate top-level "adventure instance" peer.

The campaign should persist progress such as visited locations, completed or bypassed scenes, revealed secrets, completed/failed objectives, encounter outcomes, claimed treasure, active clocks/threats, started/completed session ids, status, and explicit deviations from authored assumptions.
design:
The implementation may introduce a structured campaign-owned object (AdventureRun / CampaignModuleBinding / ActiveAdventureModule / ModuleProgressState). It must live inside campaign instance state and reference the immutable module; it must never be written back to the adventure module source pack. It is part of the existing campaign-instance layer, not a new fifth layer.

Suggested shape (campaign-owned, one per active module):
- activeModuleId (reference to the immutable module)
- status
- startedAtSessionId
- completedAtSessionId
- visitedLocations
- completedOrBypassedScenes
- revealedSecrets
- completedOrFailedObjectives
- encounterOutcomes
- claimedTreasure
- activeClocksOrThreats
- moduleDeviations
- notes

A campaign may hold more than one such adventure run / module binding.

Do not require a strictly linear module state machine. A module should support nonlinear exploration, skipped scenes, alternate routes, and emergent deviations. Progress is the only mutable side; the referenced module source remains immutable and re-forkable.
acceptance_criteria:
- Campaign instance state can record one or more campaign-owned adventure runs / module bindings.
- The campaign-owned object references the immutable module id and holds the mutable progress for that campaign; the module source is never mutated.
- The object is explicitly part of campaign instance state, not a separate top-level content/state layer (no "adventure instance" peer layer).
- Module progress can represent active module id, status, started/completed session ids, visited locations, completed or bypassed scenes, revealed secrets, completed/failed objectives, defeated/bypassed encounter outcomes, claimed treasure, active clocks/threats, and module-specific notes.
- Module deviations can be recorded explicitly when play invalidates or alters authored assumptions, as campaign facts rather than edits to the module source.
- Campaign save/resume preserves active adventure runs / module bindings and their progress.
- Tests cover starting a module, updating progress, saving, loading, and verifying the source module remains unchanged.
